sources.serving_scope: Any added multi-model queue/router is a disclosed port, not an upstream native serving feature

sources.source_status: official code release not yet located
sources.eligibility: unavailable until official code is found or a separately labeled paper reimplementation is validated; SBP-ESP policy is not a full-system result

shared_backend.identity: complete source inventory, patch digest, actual import origins, kernel selection and dependency versions; revision label alone is insufficient
shared_backend.rule: Share validated model/kernel components while preserving each external system scheduler, batching, state movement and communication design. A GFC-to-NCCL substitution is not a faithful GF-DiT reproduction.

fairness.input: Export each frozen request once; reuse identical prompt bytes, model manifest, resolution, frames, steps, CFG scale, negative prompt, scheduler settings, seed, arrival and absolute deadline.
fairness.quality: Decode the full required output before completion. Separate semantic/visual quality evaluation from finite-value and digest checks; no skipped steps, hidden cache approximation or altered precision without a separately labeled variant.

batching.native_dynamic_batching: enabled where supported; tune using calibration only
batching.legacy_batch_limit_1: existing DITSERVE controller configuration, not a requirement to disable an external system native batching

fairness.hardware: Equal total allocated GPUs, actual GPU types and topology; report resident model memory, host CPU/RAM, and cross-node placement. Time comparison runs sequentially or on disjoint nodes to control co-tenant contention.
fairness.arrival: Open-loop arrivals from one client monotonic origin. Queueing and dispatch lag count toward latency; never postpone the original deadline when admission is delayed.
fairness.denominator: All offered requests remain in SLO attainment, including rejected, failed, cancelled, unexecuted and timed-out requests. Missing results are failures, never dropped.
fairness.timing: Same start and completion boundary for every system. Report scheduled-arrival-to-output-ready and wire/serialization separately; do not compare a digest-only server to a base64 image/video response as one latency metric.
fairness.slo: One frozen per-shape SP1 service reference shared by every system; no baseline-specific SLO rescaling.
fairness.calibration: Identical split and comparable tuning budgets; allow native batching/parallelism tuning without test-set feedback; record model-specific cost profiles.
fairness.report: Per-model and per-resolution SLO attainment, goodput and latency; throughput with measurement horizon/drain convention; memory and GPU-time; three fixed test seeds and uncertainty across independent runs.
fairness.unsupported: Mark exact unsupported cells and reasons. A supported subset has its own table and cannot stand in for full mixed-workload results.

qualification_sequence: full source and shared-backend identity verification
offline exact model loading and native single-request generation
uninterrupted versus segmented/reassigned numerical validation, where applicable
two-request overlap, mixed-resolution and cross-model state isolation
calibration split tuning and source-bound profile freeze
identical held-out trace replay under equal resource allocation
independent result accounting and full-system comparison eligibility
current_policy_reimplementations: in-framework policy controls only; excluded from official external-system claims

native_support_boundaries.evidence_scope: Static audit of the frozen official commits, plus separately recorded component GPU diagnostics; not full-system qualification.

TetriServe.model_scope: One model per CServeRuntime; a same-pool SD3.5/Wan mixture requires an explicitly labelled extension.
TetriServe.batch_scope: Original split/merge regroups samples of one request ID. It is not independent-request dynamic coalescing. Each tensor batch has one resolution/seed/profile; mixed resolutions are separate requests.
TetriServe.required_runtime_dependency: pyzmq is required by the original Router/Dealer worker control plane. Direct CServeRuntime.generate bypasses only the HTTP front door.
pending_compatibility: Convert original remote Future/Work.wait float timeouts to timedelta on Torch2.10 without replacing transport.
Validate BS1/BS2 and reject unsupported nondivisible splitting; arbitrary mixed-step batches are not established.
Wan requires a video output contract and complete UniPC history, beyond the five SD3 tensors.

GF-DiT.model_scope: runtime_v2 registry contains Wan/Qwen; the ordinary diffusion registry SD3 entry does not establish runtime_v2 SD3 support. Runner and workers share one model configuration.
GF-DiT.required_runtime_dependency: Native WorkerWrapperBase, VllmConfig/workspace/model loader and Wan parallel layers use real vLLM. Lightweight control-plane dependencies alone do not satisfy this path.
GF-DiT.shared_port_scope: Preserve original MultiprocWorkerPool spawn/Pipe/readers/event loop, EDF/DAG and migration, with an explicit real xfuser model/session adapter. Do not synthesize fake vllm modules.
pending_compatibility: Bridge online logical groups and actual attention collectives to original GF collective_runtime, beyond successful SP1 migration.
Do not accept missing cost profiles returning zero for formal EDF comparison.
Treat cross-model same-pool scheduling as an added port feature, not an upstream capability.

xDiT.model_scope: Official native Wan runners can validate model/parallel execution; added serving queues or cross-model routing remain explicitly disclosed extensions.

native_support_boundaries.interpretation: An unsupported native comparison cell remains visible. A common-backend extended port has a separate label, source/patch identity and validation; it is not an untouched native-oracle result.
